title: HB2950 (2026 Regular Session): Establishes the "Gun Theft Prevention Act", which creates requirements for licensed firearm dealers to protect their inventory from theft

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 650.590 (RSMo): No person or entity licensed under 18 U.S.C. Section 923 to import, manufacture, or deal in firearms shall engage in the sale or dealing of firearms unless:
Section 650.590 (RSMo): A licensed dealer shall report the theft or loss of a firearm from the licensed dealer's inventory or collection within forty-eight hours after the theft or loss is discovered to the department of public safety and to the appropriate local law enforcement authorities.
Section 650.590 (RSMo): A security plan shall include, but not be limited to, the following security measures to deter the theft of firearms: (a) The use of metal cabinets or fireproof safes; (b) The use of security systems, video monitoring, anti-theft alarms, or a combination thereof; (c) Security gates and strong locks; and (d) Site hardening, concrete bollards, or other access controls.
